stem: Which Soviet action led to the threat illustrated on this map?

options.label: F
options.text: The signing of an arms limitations treaty

options.label: G
options.text: Blockading foreign supply ships from entering the Caribbean

options.label: H
options.text: Closing the border between East and West Berlin

options.label: J
options.text: The placement of nuclear weapons installations in Cuba

visual_elements: A black and white map showing the United States, surrounding countries, and three circles centered on Cuba with radii of 630 NM, 1020 NM, and 2200 NM, illustrating the reach of a threat from Cuba.
notes: The map clearly illustrates a missile threat range originating from Cuba, related to the Cuban Missile Crisis.
